question: 2025 年第一季的淨營收是多少？
gt_sql: WITH vo AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2025-04-01' ) SELECT ROUND((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents),0)/100.0 FROM order_items oi JOIN vo ON vo.order_id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE 1=1)-(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount_twd),0) FROM refunds r JOIN vo ON vo.order_id=r.order_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id=r.item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE 1=1),2)
